the design of high-speed, low-power, broadbanding and ESD-protected CMOS FFE circuits for 40 Gb Ethernet applications.
the design of high performance, high bandwidth, low power, high speed, and low cost equalizers for 40 Gb and 100 Gb optical communication systems.
developing high-speed, low-power and low-cost equalizers and receivers that are compatible with a standard CMOS process and a plastic package.

we have demonstrated a fully integrated 40 Gb s-1 7-tap feedforward equalizer (FFE) in a standard 65 nm CMOST process, which is the first demonstration of a fully integrated FFE operating at 40 Gb-s-1 using a standard CMOS process.
we have demonstrated that a 40 Gb/ s CMOS receiver is now possible, which is an important milestone towards commercialization of such receivers.
we have developed the first CMOS based equalizer that is capable of achieving 40 Gb performance in a 65 nm technology.
